Biomass of sorghum and maize

Source: R/data.R
SorghumMaize.Rd

Above-ground biomass of fiber sorghum, sweet sorghum and maize in central Greece, at two input levels (water and nitrogen) in four blocks, on 11 days of the year from sowing, day 141, to day 303. Not every crop was sampled on every day.

Usage

SorghumMaize

Format

A data frame with 236 rows and 5 variables:

DOY

day of the year

Block

block of the experimental design, 1-4

Input

input level: Low or High

Crop

Fiber sorghum, Maize or Sweet sorghum

Biomass

biomass in Mg/ha

Source

The data set sm of the package nlraa (version 1.9.10, licence GPL-3), with the factors labelled. The script that converts it is in the directory data-raw of the source package.

References

Danalatos, N.G., Archontoulis, S.V. and Tsiboukas, K. (2009). Comparative analysis of sorghum versus corn growing under optimum and under water/nitrogen limited conditions in central Greece. In: Proceedings of the 17th European Biomass Conference, Hamburg, 538-544.

Miguez, F. (2025). nlraa: Nonlinear Regression for Agricultural Applications. R package, https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=nlraa.

Examples

# growth from sowing, b4 = 141, to the end of growth b3, and the decline after it: the beta growth
# function, with a maximum of each crop and input level
fit <- gcTMB(Biomass ~ DOY, fform=b1 ~ Crop * Input, data=SorghumMaize, model="beta", start=c(b4=141))
summary(fit)
